Exact dependencies are in `DEPENDENCIES.json`, `SOURCES.json` and

## Mathematical checks

`PROOF.md` proves the all-f coordinate join, exact positive normalization,
literal rank-times-f header algorithm, return/cleanup, complete direct cost,
historical backing and provider-relative protected MOVE contract. It retains
valid normalized parent geometry, disjoint supplied origins/banks, exact
common grid and intermediate signed range, both monomial contracts, and
every source-to-machine premise. The new leaf descriptor is deliberately
not admitted as a general native or monomial descriptor.

`check_catalog.py` recomputes the actual fixed source family from the unchanged
word and current local constructor. It independently compares 51,948 Pauli
images and 1,477,632 exact separating-column entries for 2,886 chart pairs,
covering all 3,453 raw MOVE occurrences. The separation lemma proves complete
matrix equality; this is not described as 2,886 dense 512-by-512 replays.
Absolute phase is fixed by the complete nonzero column. Three algebra mutants
and eight typed source controls, including two true boolean/integer alias
controls, reject.

The lead separately reviewed the proof and runtime files and ran a different
arithmetic audit without importing `clifford_certificate.py`: 33,296
integer-mod-four diagonal derivative cases for n<=3 and 32 exact Fraction-pair
C-plus/minus Pauli conjugations. The lead reviewed the Z-diagonal/X-scalar
commutant proof. These are separate code-assisted AI checks with shared
source context, not human-independent or kernel-checked formal admission.

## Literal metadata and interface replay

`verify_interface.py` executes all eight prepare tables and the unchanged
release table on sparse physical tapes. Forty valid local-layout cases use
f in {1,2,3,5,17}; further cases exercise a 1024-bit unused value, a separately
labelled 257-bit-f syntax header, long-then-short reuse, zero-f rejection and
recovery, translated origins, ancestor preservation, complete work erasure
and the explicit instruction bound. Every returned header byte and all 23
values are checked against an independent encoder. The unscaled-f table
mutation is rejected.

The sparse tracker records every visited address, including blank reads and
unit movement. The reused rank-eight f=1 call costs exactly the fresh call's
7757 physical actions and 10402 instructions, while retaining 4697 private
visited cells instead of 555. Historical backing is thus distinguished from
the work of a later short call.

The interface gate also checks all eight rank inventories, exact source/owner
and chronology, source corruption, protected-control function identity,
factory-dependent whole inventories 4145 versus 4157, insufficient grants
and aliases. The 30,000-command primitive-hardware comparison uses literal
read/write/unit moves with seed19658963 and eight invalid-operation controls.
It is regression evidence; the code still executes each actual primitive.

## Completed numerical evidence

All four traces below use valid source-compatible nine-coordinate parents,
4096 complete records, 73728 physical numeric bits, arbitrary tested
spectator characters and 388 fixed private roles. Each verifies the complete
field against an independent normalized-C eigencharacter answer or unchanged
rejection input; the whole original header and all ancestor prefixes; every
returned origin; and complete work retirement.

| Trace | Actual raw event / rank | Physical actions | Observed elapsed / cap |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Positive rank-two child | 9934 / 2 | 481530645 | 77.484 s / 580 s |
| Width/cutoff rejection | 9934 / 2 | 317821 | completed; no separate timing receipt |
| Final-pair parity rejection | 9934 / 2 | 239787193 | 39.180 s / 180 s |
| Positive rank-eight child | 15619 / 8 | 1501302941 | 255.269 s / 580 s |

The cutoff input has parent f=1 and cutoff1, so checking f alone would accept
the wrong branch. The actual scaled child width2 rejects. The parity control
changes the last input record and rejects at a final C pair, preserving all
public input. Rank-eight spectator characters distinguish each selected axis
instead of testing only an eightfold cancelling phase.

`receipts/` retains exact results and available execution metadata. The
registered child gates re-execute rank-two success/cutoff/parity under normal
and optimized Python. Rank eight was completed separately; the registered
interface check validates its saved source/endpoint/space receipt without
claiming a rank-eight re-execution. Its exact standalone command is in README.

These are complete PAID child traces. No complete generic three-factor MOVE
or enclosing selected multiplication caller was executed by this package.
The protected-MOVE predecessor's whole/exit timeouts and partial physical
evidence remain unchanged and are not promoted to a complete run.

## Space measurement

Numerical array-tape receipts label `private_materialized_extents`, which
count materialized bodies, not every visited blank address. The rolewise
sums are 1387290, 7665, 920406 and 1363344 for the four rows above. They are
not asserted to be exact visited space or an all-input asymptotic theorem.

The conservative all-visited ceilings add supplied initial regions/origins
and literal actions. A unit move exposes at most one additional address.
`check_receipts.py` derives these ceilings and rejects corrupted endpoint,
unscaled width, ordinary-call and misleading visited-measurement variants.
The source proof separately bounds every role's complete history. It does
not discard a blank completed cohort or use maximum active cohort as the
total retained space.

## Registered gates and final state

`VERIFY.json` declares six commands: catalog normal/optimized (360 s each),
interface normal/optimized (60 s each), and rank-two numerical
normal/optimized (180 s each). The declared sum is 1200 s. No command is
unbounded. Exact expected marker prefixes are
`PASS_CURRENT_CODED_ALL_SOURCE_CLIFFORD`,
`PASS_CURRENT_CODED_ALL_SOURCE_INTERFACE` and
`PASS_CURRENT_CODED_ALL_SOURCE_CHILD`.

Final registered replay and its executed scope are recorded in
`FINAL-CHECKS.json` after execution. Committed-byte/mode checks and export
validation are recorded separately by the publishing orchestrator against
the frozen commit, avoiding a self-referential commit hash in the package.
A saved receipt alone is not a substitute for the registered replay. All new
package files are additions; the selected record, shared runtime and frozen
predecessor packages remain unchanged.
